details: The U.S. Department of the Treasury has designated Nobitex, Iran's largest digital asset exchange, and three other Iranian crypto exchanges, for facilitating terror finance and sanctions evasion. Nobitex allegedly processed over 50% of Iranian digital asset inflows in 2025 and helped the Central Bank of Iran access stablecoins to bypass sanctions. This action is part of the Trump Administration's "Economic Fury" campaign.
title: US Sanctions Iran's Largest Crypto Exchange Over Terror Finance

details: Escalating geopolitical tensions in the Middle East, specifically Iran's recent missile and drone strikes on targets in Kuwait and Bahrain on June 3, 2026, have negatively impacted crypto markets. In the 12 hours following the strikes, over $700 million worth of leveraged long positions in cryptocurrencies were liquidated, and the total crypto market capitalization dropped to $2.31 trillion. Brent crude oil prices also rose by 1.6%, impacting Bitcoin mining profitability due to higher energy costs. The US responded with retaliatory strikes on Iranian military installations.
title: Middle East Tensions Pressure Crypto Markets After Iran Strikes
